title: Welcome
body:
Welcome to my Japanese study notes. This is where I’ll collect vocabulary, grammar, and things I notice while reading or listening.

I’ll use these notes to keep examples I can come back to as I learn.

title: The topic particle は
body:
The particle **は** marks the topic of a sentence. When it’s used as a particle, it’s pronounced *wa*.

### Example

> 今日は雨です。  
> It’s raining today.

- **今日** means “today.”
- **は** marks 今日 as the topic.
- **雨です** tells us that it’s raining.
